name: Princeton WordNet (via OMW) (OMW 2.0)
note: One of the Open Multilingual Wordnet 2.0 release members, pinned individually because
licences differ per language and the corpus records one source per table. `decoy-inspect`
therefore reports the exact licence covering this language's word lists rather than an
umbrella that would be wrong for most of them.
Only permissively licensed members are used. German (OdeNet), French (WOLF), Dutch,
Portuguese, Romanian, Slovak, Slovenian, Lithuanian and Arabic are all CC BY-SA or
CeCILL, and share-alike does not compose with Apache-2.0, so those locales fall through
to English rather than shipping data Decoy cannot license.
